title: what made ai-assisted forge changes testable in my godot idle rpg
author: Knuckleclot
selftext:
i’m working on fellvault, a portrait idle rpg in godot. i used codex on the gdscript for the forge ui and the tests for upgrade feedback. some of the game art also uses generative ai.



the useful part for me was giving the agent a repeatable test character with the same sword, shards and refine stones. spending one shard should move the xp bar. earning the star should light the badge, spend the right amount, and give exactly the attack shown in the preview. i check refine separately so a partial upgrade never plays the rank-up reveal. those are the checks i keep in the godot tests.



this is a recording of that review build. you can see the difference between the little xp tick and the actual upgrade in the enchant tab. has anyone found a good way to give an agent a game state it can replay while debugging ui?



the android and ios v0.3 beta is coming soon. if you play idle rpgs, the waitlist is at [https://fellvault-web.vercel.app/#beta](https://fellvault-web.vercel.app/#beta)
